metadata.description: Merendon Cloud plugins — connect StashRelay and Handfrank to your AI tools.

plugins.name: stashrelay
plugins.description: A clipboard for your AI apps. Stash text in one AI conversation and pick it up in another — from any connected client, including your other devices.

plugins.name: handfrank
plugins.description: Gated agent messaging. Read released mail and prepare drafts as an approved identity — agents never send, the owner approves every outbound message.
